html: † [טֳהָר] (v. Ges§ 10. 2. B), or [טְהָר] (Ol§ 173 b Bö§ 386) n.[m.] clearness, lustre (dub. word; sub טֹהַר Hup Pe SS; so Thes, reading מִטָּהֳרוֹ)—only הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטֳּהָרוֹ ψ 89:45; De Hup Pe Sch thou hast made (him) to cease from his lustre; 𝔖 𝔙 made his lustre to cease, so AE Ki al. reading n. מִטְהָרוֹ or מִטְּהָרוֹ (D. f. according to Ges§ 20. 2. 2 b), and SchrSK 1868, 642 who reads הִשְׁבַּתָּה טְהָרוֹ; Gr proposes עטרתוֹ his crown; Bae מַטֶּה מִיָּדוֹ sceptre from his hand.
